name: Mipmap-GS
definition: A plug-in optimization method that makes 3D Gaussians adaptive for arbitrary scales by self-adjusting primitive properties (color, shape, size) and distribution (position) using scale-specific mipmap-like pseudo ground-truth.
summary: Mipmap-GS is a test-time adaptation method that eliminates aliasing in 3D Gaussian Splatting by deforming Gaussians to match scale-specific pseudo ground-truth, preserving high-frequency details better than static filtering methods.
